title: Resize Image – Pixels, Percent & Passport Sizes, No Upload
description: Resize pictures in your browser by pixels, by percent or to ready sizes for Instagram, WhatsApp and passport photos. Many at once, free, no upload.
heading: Resize Images Online
subtitle: Change a picture's size in pixels, by percent or to a ready size; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Resize pictures to an exact width and height, by a percentage, or to a ready size: Instagram square, portrait and story, a WhatsApp profile photo, or common passport photo sizes at 300 dpi. Keep the aspect ratio on to avoid stretching; ready sizes fill the frame by trimming the edges evenly. Resizing uses the Lanczos filter for sharp results.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your pictures are read and changed by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees them.

features.title: Ready sizes
features.text: Instagram, WhatsApp and passport photo sizes in one list, filled without stretching.

features.title: Many at once
features.text: Add as many pictures as you like; one result downloads as a picture, several as one ZIP file.

steps.title: Add your pictures
steps.text: Choose or drop one picture or many.

steps.title: Choose the size
steps.text: Type a width and height, pick a percentage, or choose a ready size.

steps.title: Resize and download
steps.text: Click Resize pictures and download the result, or a ZIP of all of them.

handles: Pixels: any width and height up to 16,384 px, with the aspect ratio kept or not.
Percent: from 5% to 200% of each picture's size.
Passport photos at 300 dpi: US 2 × 2 in, UK and EU 35 × 45 mm, Saudi Arabia 4 × 6 cm, India 35 × 45 mm.
limits: Passport sizes are common sizes, not official checks: confirm the issuing office's current rules for background, head size and print.
Making a picture larger can't add detail it never had.
Very large pictures (above about 100 megapixels) are limited by your device's memory.

faq.question: Are my pictures uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your pictures are read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and are never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Will my picture be stretched?
faq.answer: Not with Keep aspect ratio on. Ready sizes fill the frame and trim the edges evenly instead of stretching.

faq.question: Which passport photo sizes are included?
faq.answer: US 2 × 2 inches, UK and EU 35 × 45 mm, Saudi Arabia 4 × 6 cm and India 35 × 45 mm, all at 300 dpi. Check the issuing office's rules before you print.

faq.question: Can I resize many pictures to the same size?
faq.answer: Yes. Add them all; each one gets the same size and they download together as a ZIP.

faq.question: Does resizing keep the format?
faq.answer: Yes by default. You can also choose JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF for every picture.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
